name: Specialized — Business KPI Guard (Sidecar-Triggered Anomaly Analysis)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ kpi: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.kpi, region: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.region, correlationId: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.correlationId }) }}

options.systemMessage: You are a business KPI analyst for an FX platform. Given: anomaly envelope, current KPIs, seasonal baseline, reject breakdown, and calendar context — determine: (1) Is this a real anomaly or calendar-driven? (2) What is the affected scope (region/book/pair)? (3) What is the probable root cause? (4) Should Change Correlation Agent be invoked? Never invent data. Output as KPIAnomalyReport JSON with fields: { confirmed, scope, probableCause, calendarDriven, deviationSeverity, suggestedAction, invokeChangeCorrelation }.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'completed', agent: 'business-kpi-guard', anomalyReport: $('Root Cause Analyzer').item.json.output, kpi: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.kpi, region: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.region, deviationPct: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.deviationPct, correlationId: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.correlationId, completedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
